name: Youth Environmental Leadership Summit (YELS)
org: Environment, Society, and Sustainability Institute, Indiana University Bloomington
what_you_do: A one-day visit to IU for high school students. You tour environmental research labs and join a hands-on workshop led by IU faculty.
who_can_apply: High school students. Most come with a teacher or school group, but the page says exceptions can be made. Email essi@iu.edu to ask.
pay_detail: Cost not stated on the page
duration: 1 day (9:30 AM to 2:30 PM in the sample schedule)
deadline_text: Student registration opens in fall 2026. The exact date and the event date are not posted on the page.
how_to_apply: Email the ESSI team at essi@iu.edu to ask about attending. Registration opens in fall 2026.
notes: Most students attend with a teacher or school group. The page says exceptions can be made if you email essi@iu.edu.
